scope: persisted result archive, execution-provenance reports, negative-result lineage and claim boundaries

units.normalized_content: Defines results/ as a versioned archive of executed benchmark interpretations and negative-result lineage; archived narratives remain distinct from workflow logs and preregistration artifacts.
NR-001 preserves the original failure to localize an unsignaled model-inadequacy case; later benchmarks do not directly close that stronger original failure.
NR-002 preserves the null that the initial benchmark did not establish incremental value beyond a strong general causal reasoner.
NR-003 preserves v0.2's null: matched history-aware negative-space and general-causal search achieve the same primary selective-escalation result.

NR-004 preserves v0.3's identity null: typed general causal and negative-space-labelled histories are functionally identical on the reported benchmark; later repair/synthesis does not establish a unique mechanism.
NR-005 preserves the v0.7 boundary that repair occurs inside a supplied primitive meta-language/generator and therefore does not establish invention of the meta-language itself.
An old negative result is not closed by making old code pass; closure requires a new discriminator that directly attacks the failure, and superseded claims remain historical evidence.
Source reports first v0.1 GitHub Actions execution/run provenance and passing hostile benchmark tests; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.1 shows strong causal and causal-negative-space policies avoid guessing on the observationally equivalent hostile pair and request discriminating evidence, while naive gap/self-confirming baselines fail that control.
v0.1 does not establish a negative-space-specific advantage and leaves the original model-inadequacy/localization boundary unresolved; initial metric coverage is deliberately incomplete.
Source reports v0.1.1 validation run 31172485528 with 13/13 tests passing; the historical run identifier was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.1.1 reports that causal-negative-space search selects the model-disrupting adequacy probe while the strong causal reasoner selects additional within-model evidence; when identical model-disrupting evidence is supplied, both interpret the regimes correctly.
The positive distinction is evidence acquisition/search allocation, not superior post-evidence interpretation or a general proof of model criticism.
Source reports v0.2 validation run 31173078806 with 21/21 tests passing; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.2 reports frozen v0.1.1 negative-space over-escalation, frozen general-causal under-escalation, and perfect selective escalation/evidence selection for both matched history-aware variants with equal evidence cost and post-evidence interpretation.
v0.2 finds no incremental primary advantage for negative-space terminology/mechanism once the strong causal baseline receives the same failure-history summary and decision rule.
Source reports v0.3 validation run 31173841990 with 27/27 tests passing; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.3 reports generic compressed history at zero on frozen transfer metrics while both typed-history policies achieve perfect held-out selection/known transfer/novel model check with no false model checks.

The typed general-causal and negative-space policies use the same representation and decision rule and produce identical decisions; the gain belongs to representation quality, not a uniquely negative-space mechanism.
Source reports v0.4 validation run 31174650351 with 36/36 tests passing; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.4 reports complete selected-representation change after repair histories, held-out selection 0.0 to 1.0, Q_repair=1.0, post-repair oracle-level frozen-case performance, and representation cost increasing from 3 to 6.
v0.4 is representation selection and repair from a supplied generic candidate relation library; it does not invent relation primitives, raw sensors, or an unrestricted interface.
Source reports v0.5 validation run 31175390339 with 46/46 tests passing; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.5 reports one inadequate probe class at best-single balanced accuracy 5/6 below 0.90, successful construction of AND(pair0_close,pair1_far), perfect held-out selection for gated/always-compose controls, and search costs 114 versus 312 at equal final representation cost 11.

v0.5 establishes conditional composition using supplied primitive relations and a supplied AND constructor, not primitive operator invention, unrestricted program synthesis, label-noise robustness, or unique negative-space value.
Source reports v0.6 validation run 31176462116 with 58/58 tests passing; this historical run was not independently fetched during R37 ingestion.

v0.6 reports exact collision under all 78 frozen current-language expressions, successful boundary-inadequacy diagnosis without false expansion, preservation of adequate/unknown cases, and recoverability under an oracle supplied two additional trace operators.
v0.6 demonstrates construction-language boundary detection, not operator invention; raw ordered traces, history labels, collision comparison and expansion action are supplied.

The source reports PR run 31177528904/job 92862772195 with 70/70 tests; R37 ingestion independently fetched that successful run and logs at tested PR/merge state and verified that executable benchmark/test sources were unchanged through the later frozen release head.

v0.7 reports four transferable generated predicates from a supplied finite meta-language; boundary-gated and always-expand synthesis have identical invention/repair/transfer quality and representation cost 20, while gated search costs 5200 versus 7800 and has false expansion 0.0 versus 1.0.

v0.7 localizes the contribution to conditional search economy/timing. Construction inside supplied t0..t3 + ADD/SUB/GT/LT grammar is not invention of primitives/generator, generated predicates are not validated causal claims, and CI execution is not independent reproduction.
